lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
PM Carney heads to Commonwealth meeting in Antigua and Barbuda focused on trade, investment, The Canadian Press reports.
Budget looks to change how Canada grows: minister, The Canadian Press reports.
Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers for Michigan Senate, Politico reports.
The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year’s deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival, BBC News reports.
Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew called for the Indian Act to be abolished, which was met with echoes from Prime Minister Mark Carney who agreed that it should be scrapped, CityNews Winnipeg reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
